question: Which of the following are examples of standard one-to-one associations? (Choose two.) A. Pay Range to Legal Entity B. Location to Geozone C. Department to Division D. Location to Legal Entity
discussion: AB is correct upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
Can't Locations also have only one Legal Entity associated to it, too? Wouldn't this be a ONE-TO-ONE association, then? upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

AB is correct: A business unit consists of several departments, so you would create an association of one business unit to many departments — a ONE-TO-MANY relationship. Whereas a location can only have one geozone associated with it — this is a ONE—TO—ONE association. The type of association restricts what the user can display or enter in Employee Central — for a ONE_TO_ONE association from location to geozone, for example, the user can enter exactly one geozone for a location on the UI. upvoted 2 times Submit Cancel
